## Goal

Create a Raspberry Pi or microcontroller-based embryo that can:

- sense temperature
- blink an LED
- change behavior based on body state

## Gate

Film or document the LED reacting to body heat or a temperature signal.

## Stretch

Add a simple web dashboard showing live temperature and mood.
